important_note: Results reflect sample configurations only. They are not findings from a live AWS account.

findings.message: Allow statement grants wildcard actions on all resources.
findings.recommendation: Restrict actions and resources to the minimum permissions required.

findings.message: Allow statement contains a wildcard action or resource.
findings.recommendation: Review the wildcard and apply least privilege.

findings.message: Public access protections are disabled or false: BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets
findings.recommendation: Enable all four protections unless a documented requirement justifies otherwise.

findings.message: Default encryption is not confirmed as enabled.
findings.recommendation: Enable and verify S3 default encryption.

findings.message: Instance is running and may incur compute charges.
findings.recommendation: Confirm that the instance is needed. Stop or terminate it only after checking dependencies.
Add ownership, environment and project tags to improve cost allocation.

findings.message: Volume is unattached and may still incur storage charges.
findings.recommendation: Verify whether the volume is needed before deleting it.
